views.name: patient_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Patient.ID AS ID,
  Patient.SEX AS SEX,
  Patient.Admission AS Admission,
  Patient.Birthday AS "Birthday",
  Patient."First Date" AS "First Date",
  Patient.Description AS Description
FROM Patient
views.description: One row per patient with canonicalized demographic and admission fields (cleaning/casting but no aggregations). Exposes patient id, sex, admission status and birth/first/admission dates for downstream cohort filtering and grouping.

views.name: patient_admission_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ID,
  SEX,
  Admission
FROM patient_core
WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL
  AND Admission IS NOT NULL
views.description: Cohort view selecting patients by sex and admission status. One row per patient with the admission label; useful for counting or grouping patients by Admission and other patient attributes.

views.name: patient_examination_denorm
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Examination.ID AS "ID",
  Examination."Examination Date" AS "Examination Date",
  Patient.SEX AS "SEX",
  Patient.Admission AS "Admission",
  Examination."aCL IgG" AS "aCL IgG",
  Examination."aCL IgM" AS "aCL IgM",
  Examination."aCL IgA" AS "aCL IgA",
  Examination.ANA AS "ANA",
  Examination."ANA Pattern" AS "ANA Pattern",
  Examination.Diagnosis AS "Diagnosis",
  Examination.Thrombosis AS "Thrombosis",
  Examination.Symptoms AS "Symptoms",
  Examination.KCT AS "KCT",
  Examination.RVVT AS "RVVT",
  Examination.LAC AS "LAC"
FROM Examination
LEFT JOIN Patient
  ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
views.description: Denormalized rows combining Patient and Examination records keyed by patient ID and examination date. One row per Examination row; useful for analyses that need patient demographics alongside examination measurements and flags (e.g., thrombosis, diagnosis, antibody levels).

views.name: patient_demographics
views.body_sql:

FROM Patient
views.description: One row per patient with canonical demographic fields (sex and birthday) extracted and cast for filtering and grouping.

views.name: patient_cohort_by_sex_and_year

FROM patient_demographics
views.description: Row-level cohort view exposing patients with extracted birth year for easy filtering by sex and birth-year predicates.

views.name: patient_core_5
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Patient.ID AS ID,
  Patient.SEX AS SEX,
  Patient.Birthday AS Birthday,
  -- canonicalize Diagnosis: prefer Patient.Diagnosis, fallback to Examination.Diagnosis if available
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(TRIM(Patient.Diagnosis), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(Examination.Diagnosis), '')
  ) AS Diagnosis,
  -- canonicalize Admission: normalize common markers to either '+' or '-' or keep raw if unknown
  CASE
    WHEN TRIM(IFNULL(Patient.Admission, '')) IN ('+', 'in', 'I', '1') THEN '+'
    WHEN TRIM(IFNULL(Patient.Admission, '')) IN ('-', 'out', 'O', '0', '') THEN '-'
    ELSE TRIM(Patient.Admission)
  END AS Admission,
  -- boolean-ish flags derived from Admission
  CASE WHEN TRIM(IFNULL(Patient.Admission, '')) IN ('+', 'in', 'I', '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_inpatient,
  CASE WHEN TRIM(IFNULL(Patient.Admission, '')) IN ('-', 'out', 'O', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_outpatient
FROM Patient
LEFT JOIN Examination ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
views.description: One row per patient with canonicalized admission and diagnosis fields for cohort filtering and grouping. Keeps stable patient key and demographic/diagnosis/admission flags used by many queries.

views.name: patient_latest_laboratory
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  l.ID,
  l.Date,
  l.GOT,
  l.GPT,
  l.LDH,
  l.ALP,
  l.TP,
  l.ALB,
  l.GLU,
  l.WBC,
  l.HGB,
  l.PLT
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN (
  SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS max_date
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
) m ON l.ID = m.ID AND l.Date = m.max_date
views.description: For each patient, pick the most recent laboratory record (latest Date). Useful to report latest lab date or latest lab values per patient.

views.name: patients_with_abnormal_ua_flags
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.ID,
  MAX(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 7.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS has_abnormal_ua_male_threshold,
  MAX(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS has_abnormal_ua_female_threshold
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.UA IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.ID
views.description: Per-patient flags indicating whether the patient has any laboratory UA measurements above configurable abnormal thresholds (one flag per sex-specific threshold).

views.name: examination_with_patient_age
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Examination.ID AS ID,
  Examination."Examination Date" AS "Examination Date",
  Patient.Birthday AS Birthday,
  CAST((strftime('%Y', Examination."Examination Date") - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)
    - (strftime('%m-%d', Examination."Examination Date") < strftime('%m-%d', Patient.Birthday))
  ) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_exam
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
views.description: Denormalized row per examination joined to patient demographics with computed integer age_at_exam (years) computed from Examination.Examination Date and Patient.Birthday. Intended for filtering examinations by patient age at time of exam.

views.description: Monthly aggregated total cholesterol (T-CHO) per patient and month. Aggregates raw Laboratory rows into one row per patient per month with the sum of T-CHO and count of lab rows.

views.name: laboratory_row_level
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "ID" AS ID,
  "Date" AS Date,
  "GPT" AS GPT,
  "ALB" AS ALB,
  -- combine other available laboratory numeric/text fields into a JSON-like concatenation for portability
  -- include common lab columns beyond GPT and ALB to represent other measures
  printf('GOT=%s;LDH=%s;ALP=%s;TP=%s;UA=%s;UN=%s;CRE=%s;T-BIL=%s;T-CHO=%s;TG=%s;CPK=%s;GLU=%s;WBC=%s;RBC=%s;HGB=%s;HCT=%s;PLT=%s;PT=%s;APTT=%s;FG=%s;PIC=%s;TAT=%s;TAT2=%s;U-PRO=%s;IGG=%s;IGA=%s;IGM=%s;CRP=%s;RA=%s;RF=%s;C3=%s;C4=%s;RNP=%s;SM=%s;SC170=%s;SSA=%s;SSB=%s;CENTROMEA=%s;DNA=%s;DNA-II=%s',
    "GOT","LDH","ALP","TP","UA","UN","CRE","T-BIL","T-CHO","TG","CPK","GLU","WBC","RBC","HGB","HCT","PLT","PT","APTT","FG","PIC","TAT","TAT2","U-PRO","IGG","IGA","IGM","CRP","RA","RF","C3","C4","RNP","SM","SC170","SSA","SSB","CENTROMEA","DNA","DNA-II"
  ) AS other_lab_measures
FROM "Laboratory"
views.description: One row per Laboratory measurement (raw laboratory records) with core lab fields and patient ID for cohort filtering and joins.

views.name: laboratory_cohort_by_patient
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ID,
  COUNT(*) AS lab_records_count,
  MIN(Date) AS min_lab_date,
  MAX(Date) AS max_lab_date,
  MAX(GPT) AS max_GPT,
  MIN(ALB) AS min_ALB,
  MAX(CASE WHEN GPT > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_GPT_gt_30,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ALB < 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_ALB_lt_4
FROM Laboratory
GROUP BY ID
views.description: Aggregated laboratory-level flags and summary measures per patient across their laboratory records (e.g., min/max/any flag for criteria) to support patient-level cohort selection without re-scanning every lab row.

views.name: examination_row_level
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Examination.ID AS "ID",
  Examination."Examination Date" AS "Examination Date",
  -- normalize numeric aCL IgG/IgM/A by casting to REAL; preserve NULLs
  CASE
    WHEN Examination."aCL IgG" = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(Examination."aCL IgG" AS REAL)
  END AS "aCL IgG",
  CASE
    WHEN Examination."aCL IgM" = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(Examination."aCL IgM" AS REAL)
  END AS "aCL IgM",
  CASE
    WHEN Examination."aCL IgA" = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(Examination."aCL IgA" AS REAL)
  END AS "aCL IgA",
  -- ANA may be stored as INTEGER or text; cast to INTEGER when possible
  CASE
    WHEN Examination."ANA" = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(Examination."ANA" AS INTEGER)
  END AS "ANA",
  -- preserve original pattern text and diagnosis text, thrombosis as integer flag
  Examination."ANA Pattern" AS "ANA Pattern",
  Examination."Diagnosis" AS "Diagnosis",
  CASE
    WHEN Examination."Thrombosis" = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(Examination."Thrombosis" AS INTEGER)
  END AS "Thrombosis"
FROM Examination
views.description: One canonical row per Examination measurement with cleaned numeric lab fields and preserved original keys/dates/patterns. Casts/normalizes numeric columns that are often used in filters or comparisons and preserves raw text flags.

views.name: lab_with_patient_sex_and_ua_threshold
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Laboratory.ID AS ID,
  Patient.SEX AS SEX,
  Laboratory.Date AS Date,
  Laboratory."UA" AS UA,
  CASE
    WHEN Patient.SEX = 'M' THEN 'male_ua_threshold'
    WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' THEN 'female_ua_threshold'
    ELSE 'sex_unknown_ua_threshold'
  END AS NormalRangeThresholdUsed,
  CASE
    WHEN Laboratory."UA" IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory."UA" <= NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory."UA" <= NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE NULL
  END AS IsWithinNormalRange
FROM
  Laboratory
LEFT JOIN
  Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
views.description: Denormalized lab records joined to patient sex and a canonical uric acid threshold based on sex (threshold value not baked in here — represented as a derived field name); one row per laboratory record per patient. This view exposes the columns needed to evaluate sex-specific normal ranges for UA.

  CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory

        -- predicate to be applied at query time; placeholder kept permissive

  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_match
FROM Patient
views.description: One row per patient indicating whether they have at least one laboratory row satisfying a specified predicate. Predicate (e.g., CPK >= threshold) is applied at query time. Useful to quickly compute patient-level cohorts based on lab criteria.
